ns2:course.label: Aural Skills III
ns2:course.description: Continuation of MUS 108. Emphasis on extensions of tonality by means of changing tonal centers and altered chords. Prerequisite: MUS 102 and MUS 108, or placement by examination.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 102 and MUS 108, or placement by examination.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lecture and one discussion section.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
